p.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

en: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
u.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

en: 149:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

en: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
u.src: 2  Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

p.src: 3  Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

ja: をほめたたえよ。 タンバリンと竪琴を奏でて、
en: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
u.src: 3  Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

p.src: 4  For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

en: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
u.src: 4  For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

p.src: 5  Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

en: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
u.src: 5  Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

p.src: 6  May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

en: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
u.src: 6  May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

p.src: 7  to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

en: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
u.src: 7  to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

p.src: 8  to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

en: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
u.src: 8  to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

p.src: 9  to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!

ja: うために。 これは、主のすべての聖なる者たちの誉れである。
en: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 9  to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!

ja: 149:9 ヘブル語ではיה（ヤハ）である。
